CFS for Here With You Project Breakdown 

Project #1: PARA PO! Libreng Sakay sa Jeep ni Colet 🇵🇭

Palangga! Na-enjoy mo ba ang Libreng sakay sa Jeep ni Colet noong Homecoming ng ating Walo? Malugod po kaming nagpapa-salamat sa bawat isa na tumulong kay Coco to make this project possible! 
 
We would like to thank our Bossing Palangga (Colet Care Club), the Coca-Colets, and Blooms who donated to CFS, Pasay City Hall, Pasay Traffic and Parking Management City, Pasay PNP Office, Pasay City Rescue Team, Pasay City Fire Department, and of course, our Team COnduktors for making the ride more kwela, puno ng saya, at pagmamahal! 
 
Maraming salamat po! Coco loves each and every one of you very much! 💚
 
#ParaPo?
#ParaKayColet
#BINI_Colet
#ColetFanSuporta

Just picked up an exclusive from the past — not a relic, not a souvenir, but history itself, darned in satin and signed in sweat.
An Everlast boxing short, yes — but not just any. This is canvas royalty.
Here, in ink that once glistened like blood on gloves, five legends left their mark. Ken Norton — the marine who broke Ali’s jaw. Joe Frazier — Smokin’ Joe, who walked through fire just to throw his left hook. Larry Holmes — that jab, so pure, so cruel. And twice over, Frazier again — because once was never enough to tell his story. And Ali — yes, Muhammad Ali — boxing’s apex, the puncher who floated, stung, and rewrote what it meant to be human.
This isn’t just memorabilia. It’s the echo of Madison Square Garden, the ghosts of Zaire and Manila, the roar of the crowd when the world stood still to watch men become myth.
This is heavyweight history, laced with legend. A garment worn in war, now resting in peace — but still pulsing with the rhythm of a thousand punches.

Traffic Advisory

A Teej festival is being held at Dilli Haat Pitampura, attracting a large crowd. The road leading from Lala Jagat Narayan Marg to Dilli Haat TV Tower has been closed due to heavy  pedestrian movement. Commuters heading towards ND Market Pitampura are advised to take an alternate route:

- From Ring Road, take Wazirpur Depot towards Prem Bari Road
- Take a left turn towards Majar Road
- Then, take Kasturba Gandhi Polytechnic Pitampura Road
- Proceed towards ND Market or Gopal Mandir, depending on your destination

#DPTrafficAdvisory

[2:50PM] #OkeOdo #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is smooth from Ajegunle through Alakuko, Kola, Meiran, and Ijaiye towards Abule Egba. Movement across Jubilee Bridge towards Super is also steady, although there is a slight slowdown approaching Ile Epo due to ongoing market and bus stop activities. However, traffic improves significantly approaching Pleasure.

Traffic from Pleasure through Ile Epo down to Super is flowing well. The route ascending Jubilee Bridge from Super through Abule Egba, Awori, Ijaiye, Meiran, Kola, and Alakuko back to Ajegunle remains free and clear.

At Oja Oba, under Jubilee Bridge. Flow remains smooth up to Charity Junction.
Movement along Charity Road toward Social Club and Olayiwola, including the return leg, is running without obstruction. Traffic connecting Abattoir to Charity Junction in both directions is also moving steadily.

Our personnel are strategically positioned and actively monitoring traffic conditions to ensure continued smooth flow.

#FollowLASTMA
